title: ABBAS E ALI SHEH KE ALAMDAR SIDHARO
body:
Rukhsat ke liye aaye hain Abbase Dilawar
Bechain hain sadme se Dil e Zainabe Muztar
Nazrein kabhi baazu pa kabhi Bhai ke rukh par
Naoha ye zaba'n par ke wafadaar sidharo
<<MINI>>
Abbase Ali Sheh ke Alamdar sidharo
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab tak Mere Bhayya Tere baazu hain salamat
Baazu Mere baandhe ye kisi menahi'n himmat
Marne ki riza leke jo Tum hote ho rukhsat
Zinda'n hai hamare liye tayyar sidharo
<<MINI>>
Abbase Ali Sheh ke Alamdar sidharo
<<DIVIDER>>
Niklegi jo Kufe ko Aseero'n ki sawari
Sar peet te rote huwe karte huwe zaari
Aayegi yateemo'n ko bohut yaad Tumhari
Sab hote hain be yaaro madadgaar sidharo
<<MINI>>
Abbase Ali Sheh ke Alamdar sidharo
<<DIVIDER>>
Maaloom hua Mujhko hui khatm ladaai
Laakhon ke muqaabil hua tanha MeraBhai
Ho jayegi Bhayya ke saro tann me judaai
Ab kaon hai Bekas ka madadgaar sidharo
<<MINI>>
Abbase Ali Sheh ke Alamdar sidharo
<<DIVIDER>>
Aankhein Meri ghurbat ka sama dekh rahi hain
Uthta hua khaimon se dhua'n dekh rahi hain
Baazu pa rasan ke bhi nashaa'n dekh rahi hain
Aane ko hain khaimon me sitamgaar sidharo
<<MINI>>
Abbase Ali Sheh ke Alamdar sidharo
<<DIVIDER>>
Chaadar Meri chhin jaayegi jab Tum na rahoge
Aur shimr Sakina ko lagaaega tamaanche
Beemar pa barsenge sitamgaaron ke durre
Dhaaenge bohut zulm jafakaar sidharo
<<MINI>>
Abbase Ali Sheh ke Alamdar sidharo
author: Ali Jaweed Maqsood
